newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop, Alliance in venture.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop, Alliance in venture.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Friday it had formed an equally-owned joint venture with Alliance Capital Management L.P. to provide investment management services in Hong Kong and in the Asia region.

The joint venture New-Alliance Asset Management (Asia) Ltd to be based in Hong Kong, will provide international asset management services to individuals and institutions, Sun Hung Kai Properties said in a statement.

Alliance Capital manages US$183 billion as on December 31, 1996. It provides investment services to institutions, including pension funds, insurance companies and banks, and to individual investors through mutual fund and cash management products.
